summary: Iteration 2 backend testing of Cloud Photo Gallery API focused on the deltas: HEIC mime support, cursor-based pagination response schema (PhotoPage), album CRUD existence + auth gating + Pydantic constraints, PATCH /api/photos/{id}/album auth gating, /openapi.json reflection of new endpoints, and full regression of iteration 1 tests. 35/35 pytest cases pass (100%). Could not exercise authenticated end-to-end flows (no Cognito mailbox / no AdminConfirmSignUp IAM perm). FastAPI evaluates the security Depends BEFORE Pydantic Query/body validators, so 422 cases for sort_by/order/limit/album body can only be observed with a valid bearer; the contract is therefore verified declaratively via the OpenAPI schema. No code changes were required.

minor.issue: Not reachable via public ingress (only /api/* is routed to backend). Schema validation must use internal http://localhost:8001/openapi.json. Functional — does not impact users — but worth noting since the Swagger /docs UI is similarly inaccessible externally.

CORSMiddleware is added in server.py AFTER include_router(...) calls. Still works due to Starlette wrapping at first request, but conventional ordering is middleware before routers (carried over from iteration 1).

action_items: (Optional) If external Swagger access is desired, mount /api/openapi.json or expose /docs under /api so it survives the /api-only ingress rule.

End-to-end auth-required flows (pagination cursor decode happy-path, HEIC presigned URL minting, album CRUD body validation 422) still need a valid Cognito IdToken. Provide a pre-confirmed Cognito user's credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md or a fresh ID token, then we can extend tests to cover: real presigned PUT for image/heic, multi-page list with next_cursor round-trip, 400 on tampered cursor, 422 on name='' and name>80 chars.
critical_code_review_comments: photos_router.py: HEIC + HEIF added to ALLOWED_MIME and pillow_heif.register_heif_opener() is invoked at module import. Health endpoint succeeding implies the heif opener registered cleanly — good.

photos_router.PhotoPage schema matches review spec exactly: items: List[PhotoOut], next_cursor: Optional[str], total: int. Pagination uses base64-url-encoded offset cursor, with explicit 400 on tamper — clean.

_decode_cursor catches a broad `except Exception` and raises HTTPException(400). Consider narrowing to (binascii.Error, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, ValueError) for clarity, but functionally correct.

Offset-based cursors are decoded as raw integers — a client could iterate by guessing offsets without ever calling the API for next_cursor. Not a security issue here (results are still owner-filtered server-side) but worth mentioning. A DDB LastEvaluatedKey-based cursor would be more idiomatic and avoid recomputing the full list each page (_query_all_photos still pulls every item for the user on every page).

albums_router.py: AlbumCreate.name uses Field(min_length=1, max_length=80) — declared correctly in OpenAPI (verified). delete_album does a full _query_all to unassign photos one-by-one; for large albums this is N round-trips. Acceptable for MVP but consider BatchWriteItem or a GSI on album_id.
albums_router.delete_album returns 404 when item is missing but the route is still gated by auth — order verified (auth first, then 404). Good.

Both routers reuse the same DynamoDB table with `kind` discriminator (photo vs album). photos_router._query_all_photos filters out albums; albums_router._query_all keeps both. Risk: a photo missing `kind` would be treated as a photo (since _is_album checks `kind == 'album'`) — safe default.

patch /api/photos/{id}/album: when body.album_id is None it issues `REMOVE album_id`. The local in-memory `item` is then mutated and returned; if the DDB update_item failed partially the response could be stale — minor.
thumbnail_url still falls back to a presigned S3 GET when CLOUDFRONT_DOMAIN is empty (unchanged from iter 1). Populate after CloudFront provisioning script runs.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_photo_gallery_api.py (extended with 19 new tests covering iteration 2 deltas; iteration 1 cases retained as regression)
test_credentials: Still not present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Authenticated flows remain untested.
seed_data_creation: None — all tests are read-only / negative-path / schema introspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1 baseline + iteration 2 deltas (HEIC, PhotoPage pagination, albums CRUD, PATCH album) are fully green at the contract level. The only meaningful gap is authenticated E2E — to close it: (1) create or confirm a Cognito user in pool ap-south-1_uEX9otfnG via AWS console, (2) drop email/password in /app/memory/test_credentials.md, (3) add an authenticated_client fixture that POSTs /api/auth/login and uses returned IdToken. Then we can verify: HEIC presigned URL 200, image/bmp 400, list_photos PhotoPage round-trip with cursor, tampered cursor -> 400, album create 200 + name='' -> 422 + name>80 -> 422, PATCH photo album, DELETE album cascade-unassign. Note: /openapi.json must be hit via http://localhost:8001 internally (ingress is /api-only).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial test failures were due to incorrect test expectations: I asserted 422 for invalid query/body params when FastAPI runs the security Depends first and returns 401. Reworked those tests to assert auth-gating and verify the validation constraints declaratively via the OpenAPI schema (response model ref = PhotoPage, limit minimum=1 maximum=100, AlbumCreate.name minLength=1 maxLength=80, all album & patch routes present).
